summary_md: **Kalyan ([@YallaSaikalyan](https://x.com/YallaSaikalyan/status/2115891317632823771))** recommends the **MPO** paper ([arXiv 2610.35013](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35013)), which trains agents by scoring each step first and then the tokens inside it, since agent failures are usually whole wrong steps.

referenced_urls.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

relevance: Turn-level credit assignment for multi-step agents.

media.description: Hand-drawn diagram "Agents mess up whole turns, so score turns first": agent task → credit each turn → split it across tokens.
